A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' [[Parent/Legends|fathered]] a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] named [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]]. He trained his son to fire a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] and recognized his potential as a [[Sniper/Legends|marksman]] and his high intelligence. The male [[Death/Legends|died]] in battle, after which Sheelal inherited his [[Mumuu/Legends|mumuu]] [[Helmet/Legends|mask]]. Sheelal later changed his name to Grievous and became a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] after a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Crash of the Martyr|crash]] by [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], carving a mask for himself that resembled his father's death mask.

==Biography==
[[File:Grievoushead-OP.png|thumb|right|250px|Grievous carved a mask to resemble his father's death mask.]]
The [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]] was raised during the brutal period of the [[Huk War]], where the [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;derogatorily called the Huk&mdash;invaded Sheelal's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]]. Sheelal's [[Parent/Legends|father]] encouraged his [[Gender/Legends|son's]] anger against the Yam'rii by teaching him to fire a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slug-rifle]] with great precision. He discovered his son's intellect and [[Sniper/Legends|marksmanship]] in the process, and the young Kaleesh had already [[Death/Legends|killed]] forty Yam'rii by the [[Time/Legends|time]] he turned eight [[Standard year|years]] old, his military prowess growing to a point where his own people considered him a [[Deity/Legends|demigod]].<ref name="Unknown" />

By [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Sheelal's father died in battle, and the son [[Grievous's masks/Legends|inherited]] a [[mumuu]] [[Helmet/Legends|mask]] from him. Sheelal met a Kaleesh [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] named [[Ronderu lij Kummar]], who fought by Sheelal's side and was rumored to have been his half-sister. Her death in battle drove Sheelal to bury his grief by taking the name Grievous while also expanding his [[Grievous's family/Legends|family]] by taking ten [[Marriage/Legends|wives]] and fathering thirty children, making his own father a grandfather. Grievous eventually survived a [[Martyr|shuttle]] [[Crash of the Martyr|crash]] that required him to become a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] to survive. The [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] was initially unsatisfied with his new soulless [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] face, so he carved an [[Armorplast/Legends|armorplast]] mask that resembled his father's death mask and had it grafted onto his alloy [[Bone/Legends|skull]].<ref name="Unknown" />

==Personality and traits==
Grievous's father encouraged his son's anger against the Yam'rii by teaching him to fire a [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] and observed his intellectual and marksmanship abilities.<ref name="Unknown" />

==Equipment==
Grievous's father had a mask<ref name="Unknown" /> carved from the [[Skeleton/Legends|skull]] of a mumuu, a creature on whom Kaleesh warriors would prove their worth by [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|342|mumuu}}</ref> Grievous inherited and wore the mask after his father died. The father also had a death mask.<ref name="Unknown" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grievous's father was first mentioned in "[[Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous]]," an article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 86|eighty-sixth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'',<ref name="Unknown" /> published on [[February 13]], [[2006]].<ref name="Insider date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20060125.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars Insider'' #86}}</ref>
